definitions.explanation: The act of putting money into financial schemes, property, or business ventures with the expectation of profit.
Devoting resources like time or effort to something with expectation of future benefit.

examples.japanese: {株式|かぶしき}に{投資|とうし}する。
{不動産|ふどうさん}{投資|とうし}で{利益|りえき}を{得|え}た。
examples.english: Made a profit from real estate investment.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}への{投資|とうし}は{重要|じゅうよう}だ。

notes:
{投資|とうし} is a compound: {投|とう} (throw/put in) + {資|し} (capital).

TYPES OF {投資|とうし}:
- {株式|かぶしき}{投資|とうし} (stock investment)
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{投資|とうし} (real estate investment)
- {設備|せつび}{投資|とうし} (capital investment)
- {海外|かいがい}{投資|とうし} (overseas investment)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投資|とうし}する (to invest)
- {投資|とうし}を{行|おこな}う (to make an investment)
- {投資家|とうしか} (investor)
- {投資|とうし}{信託|しんたく} (investment trust/mutual fund)
- {投資|とうし}{対象|たいしょう} (investment target)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {出資|しゅっし} (capital contribution)
- {融資|ゆうし} (financing/loan)
